title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who violates any provisions of sections 286-62 to 286-68 shall be fined not more than $50.
bodyHtml: §286-69  Penalty.  Any person who violates any provisions of sections 286-62 to 286-68 shall be fined not more than $50. [L 1955, c 67, §8; RL 1955, §160-227; am L 1967, c 214, §14; HRS §286-69]
